newsitem.title: FINLAND: Sampo, Merita co-op talks end.
newsitem.headline: Sampo, Merita co-op talks end.

text.p: Finnish insurance group Vakuutusosakeyhtio Sampo and banking group Merita Oy said in separate statements on Thursday they had been in talks about cooperation, but the talks had ended without results.
Merita said it had also been in talks about cooperation with another Finnish insurance group, Vakuutusosakeyhtio Pohjola, but that these talks, too, had now ended.
"No merger preparations are under way," Sampo said.
"Talks between Sampo and Merita about various ways of cooperation were held during the latter part of 1996. The talks have, however, ended without results," Sampo said.
Merita said it had talked with Sampo about cooperation alternatives during the autumn of 1996.
"Last autumn, (Merita) has been separately in corresponding talks also with Pohjola," it said.
"Both talks have ended without results," Merita said.
